title: A Field Guide to Lies and Statistics
author: Daniel J. Levitin
description: A sharp, witty guide to critical thinking in the age of information overload, teaching readers to question data, detect manipulation, and make smarter decisions.

file: All That We See Or Seem by Ken Liu.jpg
title: All That We See Or Seem
author: Ken Liu
description: A lyrical exploration of perception, reality, and the stories we tell ourselves, woven with the quiet precision and emotional depth Ken Liu is known for.

title: Becoming
author: Michelle Obama
description: An intimate and powerful account of Michelle Obama's journey from Chicago's South Side to the White House, a story of identity, ambition, and what it means to use your voice.

title: Fooled by Randomness
author: Nassim Nicholas Taleb
description: A provocative argument that we consistently underestimate the role of chance in our lives, markets, and success, and that we are wired to see patterns where none exist.

title: Steve Jobs
author: Walter Isaacson
description: The definitive biography of Apple's visionary co-founder, drawn from over forty interviews with Jobs himself, a candid portrait of genius, obsession, and the relentless pursuit of perfection.
